categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies contrib/verify-binaries/, which is tooling under contrib used for release verification, covered by Build and CI.
categories.rationale: Release binary verification could succeed using entirely expired or revoked GPG keys without any active signing key, undermining release integrity. As noted in the description, this issue was discovered and disclosed by the Red Team, making it a critical release-integrity correctness fix.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py, a command-line verification script under contrib.
categories.rationale: Fixes signature counting in contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py to exclude expired and revoked keys from satisfying the binary quorum by default. The tools area prioritizes tools that operators depend on and the correctness of scripts handling cryptographic keys.
